findings.quote: The judge must decide this personally after examining the complainant and any witnesses under an oath or affirmation, a formal promise to tell the truth.
findings.problem: The preceding sentence applies this procedure to both search and arrest warrants. For arrest warrants, personal determination of probable cause does not require the judge personally to examine complainants or witnesses; evaluation of the prosecutor’s report and supporting records can suffice. This conflates the procedures. Source basis: Article III Section 2 read with the settled distinction in Soliven v. Makasiar; no external source was opened under the prompt-only restriction.
